fields.mechanism: Sulphite concentration in wine influences lateral vehicle control (standard deviation of position) in demanding urban driving environments, distinct from the BAC effects seen in free-flow conditions.
fields.intervention: Implement a driver-cognitive and vehicle-dynamics co-adaptation algorithm for the high-performance road car that monitors real-time environmental complexity (urban vs. rural) and driver physiological state, adjusting the Electronic Stability Control (ESC) intervention threshold and lateral steering assist gain to compensate for elevated lateral standard deviation in high-demand zones.
fields.expected_effect: Reduction in lateral position variance and improved vehicle stability during high-speed urban maneuvering, enabling safe operation at higher performance limits without violating road legal engineering constraints.
fields.falsification_test: Conduct a controlled test where the driver operates the car in a simulated urban environment with induced cognitive load; measure the standard deviation of lateral position with the adaptive ESC active versus a baseline constant-gain ESC; verify that the active system reduces lateral deviation by more than 15% relative to baseline.
fields.mechanism_source_span: only BAC affected lateral vehicle control along curves

fields.mechanism: Increased lateral vehicle control variance caused by biological agent (BAC/sulphites) reducing driver precision in demanding environments.
fields.intervention: Implement a closed-loop active steering stability control system that monitors driver-induced lateral deviation and automatically corrects steering input to mitigate the increased standard deviation of lateral position relative to the sober baseline.
fields.expected_effect: The vehicle maintains a stable lateral trajectory through curves despite driver impairment or high-speed instability, preventing deviation from the intended path.
fields.falsification_test: Subject the vehicle to a slalom course at a speed near the handling limit while a simulated 'driver' input applies periodic lateral disturbances; if the vehicle deviates from the reference path by more than 15 cm without active correction, the mechanism fails.
fields.mechanism_source_span: only BAC affected lateral vehicle control along curves, increasing the standard deviation
